spanish: Y será el campo en su salir en el yovel santidad a Jehová, como campo del jérem; al sacerdote será su posesión.

findings.issue: Common noun H3104 is left as the untranslated lemma yovel; common nouns stay Spanish.
Common noun H2764 is left as the untranslated lemma jérem; common nouns stay Spanish.

notes: Remaining tokens match: both H1961 as será, field, its going out, holiness to Jehová, like the field of the devoted thing, to the priest, his possession.
